Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3681 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> and [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] summoned a [[Force storm (weather)|storm]] of [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]] that '''disintegrated''' an [[Unidentified Jabiimi city|entire city]] of rebellious [[Jabiimi|natives]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], which was under the control of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The act gained Fulminiss great fame and respect among his comrades in the Empire, and it added to his reputation as a master of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] and mass [[Speciecide|extermination]].<ref name="Fulminiss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[City/Legends|city's]] destruction was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Fulminiss within ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Fulminiss" />
